required_outer_gates: Fixed target and source pins before bootstrap, exact TLS availability and mandatory complete log inventories before credentials.
Exclusive root-private whole-row backup validated and fsynced before apply; preserved recovery snapshot.
No retry after intent or ambiguous commit; bounded process containment and honest failure/recovery reporting.
limitations: Global default1001 split can affect other selectors; no per-partner isolation claim.
Native timestamps are expressly permitted deltas.
ORM external cache/events need separate runtime verification; DB rollback is not external cache rollback.
No VM/API or live DB calls by reviewer.
